task_context.problem_statement: The value of $y$ varies inversely as $\sqrt x$ and when $x=24$, $y=15$. What is $x$ when $y=3$?

Fine. Inverse variation means $y = k / \sqrt{x}$, so $y\sqrt{x} = k$. I used $15 \cdot \sqrt{24} = k$. Then for the second part, I did $3 \cdot \sqrt{x} = 15 \cdot \sqrt{24}$. Is that the right way to set it up?
